title: Live Container Integration Suite Withheld on Small Host
description: 17 container-dependent integration tests in backend/tests/integration/ require a live PostgreSQL 16 and Qdrant instance. Execution was withheld because host available physical RAM (~1041 MB) is below the mandatory 2048 MB memory safety threshold.
closure_requirement: Run on CI runner (GitHub Actions / Linux runner with >= 4 GB RAM) or host with >= 2048 MB free RAM.

title: Source-Derived PDF Word/Span Bounding Box Extraction Deferred
description: PDF citation highlighting currently renders preserved ingestion bounding boxes with synthetic standard US Letter geometry fallback. Word-level span extraction via PyMuPDF get_text('words') is deferred to post-M05.
